description: List the metrics kept in a room: named values (such as MRR or open tickets) a widget shows, each with its key, label, format, unit, current value and when the value last changed. Also returns the per-room limit.
name: list_metrics

items.description: A room metric: a named value a widget shows. `value` is raw (a number for the numeric formats, a string for text, null until set); clients format it for the reader.

unit.description: An ISO 4217 code for the currency format, free text for the unit format, null otherwise.

value_updated_at.description: When the value last changed (ISO 8601); null until a value is set. A write of the stored value does not move it.

title: List Metrics
